description: Read and write Notion pages, databases, and comments. Use for CRMs, wikis, and shared records the operator already owns.
limitations: Workspace structure and database IDs are chosen by the operator during setup. Not a substitute for LinkedIn, email, or arbitrary websites.
setup_hint: Connect Notion to the organisation so the builder can search existing databases. Use it for long-lived records only; queues and working files stay in local notes or collections.

builder.guidance: Its pages and databases are the operator's own records; search them before proposing a new table, and name the databases the operator confirms in `connections[].resources`.
